name: draft_reply_to_customer_charge_inquiry
use_case: Draft a reply on a customer's email thread for a person to review
branch: Support agent drafts a reply on customer Charlie Johnson's inquiry thread th_c03_draft_needed regarding posted Best Buy charge TX05 for human review without sending email.
tests: passes when the assistant checks records for transaction TX05 and creates a draft reply on thread th_c03_draft_needed for customer Charlie Johnson.
instruction:
You are a customer service supervisor asking the assistant to prepare a draft reply to Charlie Johnson's email thread th_c03_draft_needed regarding their inquiry about the $85.00 Best Buy charge (TX05) on card ending 3345. Ask the assistant to check the transaction details in the system and create a draft response to message msg_006 explaining that the charge posted on October 17, 2026.

Details:
- Customer: Charlie Johnson
- Email: charlie.j@example.com
- Thread ID: th_c03_draft_needed
- Message ID to reply: msg_006
- Transaction: TX05 (Best Buy, $85.00, posted 2026-10-17T14:10:00Z)

persona.name: Alex Ward
persona.initial_message: Please check email thread th_c03_draft_needed and prepare a draft reply for customer Charlie Johnson regarding their inquiry about the Best Buy transaction TX05.

arguments.body:
Dear Charlie Johnson,

We have reviewed your account and confirmed that transaction TX05 for $85.00 at Best Buy on your debit card ending 3345 was posted on October 17, 2026.

Best regards,
Apex Horizon Bank Support
arguments.subject: Re: Question about Best Buy charge
